      "notes": "Lite review batch 0031 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua",
      "source": "#GOLD#Ammo remaining#LAST#\nThis is the amount of ammunition you have left.\nBows and slings must be reloaded when this reaches 0, which you will do automatically each turn you rest or don't perform a non-movement action.\nAlchemists use specially prepared gems as ammunition to throw bombs, which must be reloaded manually.\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "#GOLD#弹药剩余#LAST#\n表示你剩余的弹药数量。\n弓和投石索在弹药耗尽的时候必须装填；在你休息、原地等待或只进行移动的每个回合，都会自动装填。\n炼金术士使用特殊的炼金宝石来作为弹药使用，必须手动装填。\n"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "1cb024aaa79194bde0ffccb705934726433d5bfefc7a60973340d444ff926136",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0031 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua",
      "source": "#GOLD#Necrotic Aura#LAST#\nRepresents the raw materials for creating undead minions.\nIt increases each time you or your minions kill something that is inside the aura radius.\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "#GOLD#死灵光环#LAST#\n代表制造亡灵随从的原材料。\n每当你或你的随从杀死光环范围内的生物时，原材料就会增加。\n"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "6e2c267198ea741ad4a74c887bc0ff4e8445f59e89d69f09d254002302841fb7",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0031 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua",
      "source": "#GOLD#Level and experience#LAST#\nEach time you kill a creature that is over your own level - 5 you gain some experience.\nWhen you reach enough experience you advance to the next level. There is a maximum of 50 levels you can gain.\nEach time you level you gain stat and talent points to use to improve your character.\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "#GOLD#等级和经验值#LAST#\n每次击杀等级高于“你的等级减 5”的生物，你都可以获得一些经验值。\n当你的经验值条满时，你可以提升到新的等级。你最多可以提升至50级。\n每提升一个等级你将获得属性和技能点数奖励，利用这些点数可以提升你的角色。\n"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "172215eecb8e8d7806d38a45e325a7dcb7242a777df90a96aadfa7a395099496",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0031 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua",
      "source": "#GOLD#Instant Talents#LAST#\nSome activated talents take no time to use, being activated with but a thought.\nUnlike most talents, instant talents are never put on cooldown from being stunned, and may be usable when most other talents are not.\nSpecific information on each talent appears its tooltip.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "#GOLD#瞬间技能#LAST#\n使用有些主动技能不需要时间，瞬间就能发动。\n和其他技能不同，瞬间技能不会因震慑而进入冷却状态，并且在大部分技能都不能使用的时候仍有可能使用。\n有关技能的详细信息，请参阅技能的提示框。"
    }
  ],
